mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of the rate level.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is observed (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2.5% and industrial production (INDPRO) is below 100, the combination signals a stable economic environment with accommodative monetary policy and weak supply, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic expansion, high housing starts (HOUST > 1250) signal strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1250 and in a late-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market slack and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: The current level of industrial production (INDPRO) is a key supply indicator that, when observed, signals weak economic output and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is observed (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1250 and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 500000, the combination signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS > 500000 (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tight regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), high employment (PAYEMS > 150000) signals strong labor market conditions and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150000 (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).
